info.name: Booknow API v1
info.description:
## Booknow REST API v1 — Mobile Application

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}/agency/{{tenant}}/api/v1`  
**Auth**: Bearer token (set via `{{token}}` variable after Login)  
**Content-Type**: `application/json`

### Token Abilities
| Ability | Scope |
|---------|-------|
| `read` | Results, seat map, fare rules, orders, reports, wallet, eSIM catalogue |
| `write` | Search, select, price, book (flights, hotels, insurance, eSIM) |
| `issue` | Issue ticket, void/refund, change segment, eSIM refund |
| `report` | Dashboard & reports |
| `*` | Full access |

### Quick Start
1. Set `base_url` and `tenant` (e.g. `median`)
2. Run **Login** — token is saved to `{{token}}` automatically
3. Flights: Search → Results → Select → Seat Map → Price → Book
4. eSIM upsell during flight booking: **Airport Packages** with destination IATA
5. eSIM standalone: Search → Packages → Select → Book
6. Hotels: Autocomplete → Search → Details → Select → Book (use `city` + numeric `city_id` + structured `rooms`)
7. For ticket changes use **Change Segment** folder

### Recent Updates
- **Hotel search payload** — requires `city` + numeric `city_id` from autocomplete; `rooms` as `[{ "adult": 2, "children": [5] }]` (flat `rooms`/`adults`/`children` only when children is 0 or ages provided)
- **Travel & Orange issue** — `POST /insurance/travel/issue`, `POST /insurance/orange/issue` (requires `issue`)
- **API token management** — `POST /auth/tokens` create scoped token, `DELETE /auth/tokens/{tokenId}` revoke by id
- **Insurance Policy PDF** — `GET /orders/{order}/insurance-items/{item}/policy-pdf` returns the Al Baraka printable policy PDF (compulsory, travel, orange)
- Order detail insurance items include `report_reference` for print lookup
- **eSIM API** — full catalogue and booking flow
- `GET /esim/airport/{iata}/packages` — destination airport bundles for flight-booking upsell
- `POST /esim/search` → `GET /esim/results/{uuid}/packages` → `POST /esim/select` → `POST /esim/book`
- `POST /orders/{order}/esim-items/{item}/refund` — refund issued eSIM (requires `issue`)
- Orders list filter: `product_type=esim`
- Cabin filter: `cabin_class` = `all` | `Y` | `C` | `F`
- Offers include `baggage`, `airline_logo_url`, `fare_id`, ISO8601 `duration` (`PT4H`, `PT2H10M`)
- `POST /flights/open-reservation-availability` — check if open reservation (QQ) is allowed for an offer
- `POST /flights/fare-rules` — plain-text rules (no line numbers)
- `POST /flights/seatmap` — interactive seat map with per-seat pricing
- `POST /flights/price` — total with seat fees and ancillaries
- `POST /flights/book` accepts `extras.seats` for seat assignment
- Draft booking: `ticketing_mode: draft` then `POST .../tickets/issue`
- Change segment: search → results → quote → confirm

### Response Format
```json
{ "success": true|false, "message": "...", "data": {...} }
```

variable.description: Destination airport IATA for eSIM upsell during flight booking
Al Baraka EncryptedId / card number from issue or order detail
Personal access token ID — set from List Tokens or Create Token
Optional: set from search results rateKey

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. Run Login first to get a token.

Returns the currently authenticated user profile.

exec: console.log('New token created. Store securely — it will not be shown again.');

request.description:
Create a new scoped API token for the authenticated user.

**Body**
- `name` (required) — token label
- `abilities` (optional) — `read` | `write` | `issue` | `report`. Omit or use `["*"]` for full access.

The plain-text token is returned once in `data.token`. Store it securely.

Revoke a specific personal access token by id. Users can only revoke their own tokens.

Use **List Tokens** first to populate `{{token_id}}`.
Revoke the current Bearer token. After this, the token is invalid.

query.description: IATA code (3 chars) or city/country name. Empty returns popular airports.

request.description: Search airports by IATA code, city, or country name.
Returns all active airlines available to the tenant. Each airline includes a `logo_url` for direct use in the UI.

query.description: default | icon | tail | icon-transparent | icon-white | logo-bg-white

request.description: Returns the airline logo image (PNG). Also available as `airline_logo_url` on each flight offer and `logo_url` on the airlines list.

item.name: ✈️ Flights
item.description:
Flight search, pricing, and booking flow.

**Book flow**: Search → Results → (Open Reservation check) → (Fare Rules) → Select → Seatmap → Price → Book (`ticketing_mode: final` or `draft`)

**Open reservation**: After **2. Fetch Results**, call **2c. Open Reservation Availability** per offer. If `allowed: true`, pass `reservation_type: QQ` in **5. Select Flight**.

**Seat flow**: **5b. Seat Map** → pick seats → **5c. Price** (with `extras.seats`) → **6. Book** (same `extras.seats`)

**Draft flow**: Book with `ticketing_mode: draft` → Issue Ticket

**Change flow**: See **Change Segment** folder

request.description:
Create a flight search session. Returns a UUID to use in subsequent calls.

**cabin_class**: `all` (default) | `Y` (economy) | `C` (business) | `F` (first)

**Round-trip**: set `is_return: true` and add `return_date`.

Fetch flight offers from a specific provider for the given search session.

Each offer includes:
- `duration` and `segments[].duration` in ISO8601 format (e.g. `PT4H`, `PT2H10M`)
- `baggage`: `{ hold_weight, hand_weight, hold_pieces }`
- `airline_logo_url`
- `fare_id` (use with **Fare Rules**)
- `pricing.cabin_type` for cabin filtering

During a **change search**, the session is locked to the issuing airline (`locked_provider_id`).

Fetch fare notes / ticket rules for a class using the Videcom FN command.

Pass `fare_id` from the selected offer's `pricing.fare_id` or top-level `fare_id`.

`rules` is returned as plain text with Videcom line numbers stripped.

Requires `read` ability.

Check whether **open reservation** (Videcom `QQ`) is available for a flight offer before selection.

Call once per offer after **2. Fetch Results**. Pass the full offer object (or at minimum `flight_number`, airports, `departure_time`, and class/`pricing.class_code`).

If `data.allowed` is `true`, the mobile app may show an "Open Reservation" option and pass `reservation_type: "QQ"` in **5. Select Flight**.

Optional `provider_selector` for agency-network / default-agency supply routing (same as web UI).

Requires `read` ability.
Lowest priced date hints for a full month. `null` means no cached fare for that date.
Fetch return flight options for a round-trip booking. Pass the selected outbound flight.
Select a flight offer for booking. Caches the selection server-side.

Fetch interactive seat map for a flight segment.

Use `flight_number` and `date` from the selected offer segment. Each seat includes `code`, `price`, `is_occupied`, and grid position.

Requires `read` ability.

Calculate total price for the selected flight including seat fees and ancillary services.

**extras.seats format**: `{ passengerIndex: { segmentNumber: seatCode } }`
- `passengerIndex`: 0-based
- `segmentNumber`: 1-based

Example: `"0": { "1": "12A" }` = passenger 1, segment 1, seat 12A.

Requires `write` ability. Call after **Select Flight**.

Finalize booking and issue ticket immediately (`ticketing_mode: final`, default). Creates order, charges wallet, and issues e-ticket. Must call **Select Flight** first.

Pass `extras.seats` (same format as **5c. Price**) to assign seats during booking.

For hold-only PNR without payment, use **6b. Book Flight — Draft Reservation**.

response.name: 402 — Insufficient Balance

request.description:
Hold a PNR without issuing or charging wallet (`ticketing_mode: draft`).

Order status is `pending`. Finalize later with **7. Issue Ticket**.

Supports `extras.seats` (same format as **5c. Price**).

Requires `write` ability.

response.name: 201 — Draft Created

request.description:
Issue a ticket for a **draft** pending booking. `booking_id` is the order ID from the draft book step.

For `ticketing_mode: final` bookings, the ticket is already issued at book time — this endpoint is only needed for drafts.

`payment_type`: `airline_token` (default) or `cash`.

Requires `issue` token ability.

response.name: 402 — Insufficient Balance
503 — Timeout

request.description:
Fetch a refund quote (penalty + net refund amount) for a specific ticket item. Read-only — no state is changed. Present the returned amounts to the user before calling **Refund Ticket**.

Requires `issue` token ability.

response.name: 503 — Timeout

request.description:
Void a ticket. Only possible on the **same calendar day** as issue. If the ticket was issued on a previous day, use **Refund Ticket** instead.

Requires `issue` token ability.

response.name: 422 — Not Voidable
503 — Timeout

request.description:
Refund a ticket after the void window has passed. Use **Refund Quote** first to obtain the correct `penalty_amount` and `refund_amount` values to pass in the body.

Requires `issue` token ability.

response.name: 422 — Rejected by Airline
503 — Timeout

item.name: 🔄 Change Segment
item.description:
Change a ticket segment on the **issuing airline only**.

**Flow**:
1. **Change Search** → saves `flight_uuid` + `flight_provider_id`
2. **Fetch Results** (in Flights folder) → pick a new offer
3. **Change Quote** → review fees (`outstanding_amount`)
4. **Change Confirm** → apply change

Requires `issue` ability. Set `order_id` and `item_id` from a booked order (auto-saved after Book, or from **Order Detail**).

request.description:
Start a change search locked to the ticket's issuing airline.

Returns a new `uuid` — fetch offers with **2. Fetch Results** in the Flights folder using `?provider_id={{flight_provider_id}}`.

**segment_line**: 1-based segment index on the ticket.

**cabin_class**: `all` | `Y` | `C` | `F` (optional, default `all`).

query.description: Offer id from Fetch Results (change search)

request.description:
Quote change fees before confirming. Read-only.

Pass `new_segment_code` from the selected offer's `id` field.

`change_type` is `revalidation` (same route/class) or `reissue` (route/class change).

Apply the segment change after the user accepts the quote.

Pass `outstanding_amount` from the quote response. Wallet deduction for change fees is not yet applied via API (same as web).

item.name: 🏨 Hotels
item.description:
Hotel search and booking via the active tenant hotel provider (e.g. 3T).

**Flow**: Autocomplete → Search → Details → Select → Book

**Search requirements (provider-ready)**:
- `city` — destination label from autocomplete (e.g. `Paris, France`)
- `city_id` — **numeric** id from autocomplete (`city_id` / `code`)
- `rooms` — occupancy list: `[{ "adult": 2, "children": [5] }]` (`children` = ages, not a count)
- Optional flat shortcut: `rooms: 1`, `adults: 2`, `children: 0` (if `children` > 0, send `children_ages`)

Run **Autocomplete** first — it saves `{{hotel_city}}` and `{{hotel_city_id}}`.

**Book requirements**: `customer.city` and `customer.country` are required (3T rejects bookings without them).

**Book note**: clients send `rooms[].guests`; the API maps to provider `rooms[].paxes` + `ratekey` automatically.

request.description: Search destinations by name. Use the returned `city_id` (numeric) and `label` as `city` on **Search Hotels**. Saves `{{hotel_city}}` and `{{hotel_city_id}}`.

Search available hotels.

**Required**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `city` | string | Label from autocomplete |
| `city_id` | integer | Numeric id from autocomplete |
| `check_in` / `check_out` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | checkout after checkin |
| `rooms` | array | `[{ "adult": 2, "children": [5] }]` — children are **ages** |

Optional: `language`, `page`.

Saves `{{hotel_search_uuid}}` (and `{{hotel_rate_key}}` when present).

response.name: 422 — Missing city / city_id

request.description: Alternate search body for simple adult-only occupancy. If `children` > 0, also send `children_ages` matching the count (or prefer structured `rooms[].children` ages on **Search Hotels**).
Example with children: `rooms[].children` is an array of **ages** (not a child count).
Get full hotel details, description, images, and amenities.
Select a room/rate and check availability. Requires a valid `search_uuid` from Search. Returns `booking_uuid` for Book.

Finalize hotel booking with guest details. Must call **Select Hotel Offer** first.

The API accepts `rooms[].guests` and maps them to the provider `paxes` + `ratekey` shape (rate key comes from Select, or optional `rooms[].rate_key`).

**Required customer fields**: `first_name`, `last_name`, `country`, `city`.
Optional: `email`, `phone`/`mobile`.

For children use `civility: "Enf"` and `age`.

response.name: 422 — Missing customer city/country

request.description: Calculate compulsory vehicle insurance premium.

Issue a compulsory vehicle insurance policy. Must call **Price Quote** first.

After issue, use **Orders → Insurance Policy PDF** with the returned `order_id` and insurance item id to download the Al Baraka printable policy.
Get zones, durations, nationalities, and genders for travel insurance.
Calculate travel insurance premium for one or more passengers. Use either `passengers` array or `adult_count`/`child_count`/`senior_count` counts.

Issue travel insurance policies for all passengers in the quote. Requires `issue` ability.

Must call **Price Quote** first. Then use **Orders → Insurance Policy PDF** to download each printable policy.

response.name: 410 — Quote Expired

request.description: Get countries, document types, cars, and vehicle nationalities for orange insurance.
Calculate orange insurance premium.

Issue an orange (Arab card) insurance policy. Requires `issue` ability.

Must call **Price Quote** first. Then use **Orders → Insurance Policy PDF** to download the printable policy.

response.name: 410 — Quote Expired

item.name: 📱 eSIM
item.description:
eSIM catalogue and booking.

**Flight upsell flow** (during flight booking): pass the destination airport IATA to **Airport Packages** → show bundles → if user picks one, run **Search** → **Select** → **Book**.

**Standalone flow**: **List Countries** → **Search** → **Packages** → **Select** → **Book**

**Abilities**: `read` for catalogue/airport packages; `write` for search/select/book; `issue` for refund.

Search and booking sessions expire after 60 minutes. Airport packages are cached ~30 minutes per country.

request.description:
Get eSIM bundles for a **destination airport IATA** code. Use this during flight booking to upsell eSIMs to the traveller.

Set `{{destination_iata}}` from the selected flight's arrival airport (e.g. `TUN`, `IST`).

The airport is resolved to a country ISO2 code, then packages are returned from the eSIM provider catalogue.

Requires `read` ability.

List all countries available for eSIM purchase, plus featured countries for homepage/upsell UI.

Requires `read` ability.

Start an eSIM catalogue search for a destination country.

**country**: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `TN`, `LY`, `TR`).

Returns a `uuid` valid for 60 minutes. Use with **2. Packages** and **3. Networks**.

During flight upsell, derive the country from the destination airport or use **Airport Packages** directly.

Requires `write` ability.

Fetch eSIM packages for a cached search session.

Use `package.id` from the response in **4. Select Package**.

Returns `410` if the search session expired.

Requires `read` ability.

response.name: 410 — Search Expired

request.description:
Fetch carrier network coverage for a cached search session.

Requires `read` ability.

Select a package from a search session. Returns a `booking_uuid` valid for 60 minutes.

**search_uuid**: from **1. Search**  
**package_id**: from **2. Packages** or **Airport Packages**

Requires `write` ability.

Purchase the selected eSIM and create an issued order.

Must call **4. Select Package** first. Charges the tenant eSIM provider wallet.

**customer.name** and **customer.email** are required — the eSIM activation details are delivered to this email.

Requires `write` ability.

response.name: 422 — Insufficient Balance
410 — Booking Expired

request.description:
Refund an **issued** eSIM order item. Deletes the eSIM from the provider and credits the provider wallet.

Set `order_id` and `item_id` from **5. Book** response or **Order Detail**.

Only items with status `issued` can be refunded.

Requires `issue` ability.

response.name: 422 — Not Issued

request.description: Paginated order list with filters by product type, status, and date range.

exec: var order = json.success && json.data ? (json.data.order || json.data) : null;

request.description:
Full order details with items, passengers, segments, and wallet transactions.

Insurance items include `report_reference` used by **Insurance Policy PDF**.
Download flight ticket as PDF. Returns binary PDF, not JSON.
Download hotel voucher as PDF. Returns binary PDF, not JSON.

Download the Al Baraka printable insurance policy PDF for compulsory, travel, or orange items.

Requires `read` ability.

**Flow**
1. Issue policy (or load **Order Detail** / **Order List** with `product_type=insurance`)
2. Ensure `order_id` and insurance `item_id` are set
3. Call this endpoint — response is binary PDF (`Content-Type: application/pdf`), not JSON

Uses provider report references (`EncryptedId` / policy id / orange card number) with fallback when encrypted id fails.

**Errors**
- `422` — no printable policy reference on the item
- `502` — Al Baraka report fetch failed

response.name: 422 — Missing Reference

request.description: Download order summary as PDF. Returns binary PDF, not JSON.
Revenue, order counts, growth percentages, ticket status, and recent bookings.
Daily sales breakdown by product type and currency. Defaults to last 30 days.
Commission breakdown per order item. Only items with commission > 0.
Current wallet balances per currency.
Paginated wallet transaction history with optional currency and date filters.
